text: Northwind Data announced today that it has completed its acquisition of Sparkplug Analytics, the streaming telemetry startup, in an all-stock transaction that closed on 14 March 2025.

doc_title: Northwind Data Infrastructure Blog: EU Residency
text: Our first EU data residency zone runs out of eu-central-2 (Zurich). We picked it over eu-west-1 because Swiss data protection law gave our regulated customers a cleaner story, and because the region already had the three availability zones our replication design requires.

doc_title: Northwind Data Infrastructure Blog: EU Residency
text: For eu-central-2 we published a p99 read latency target of 45 ms measured at the regional edge, and a p99 write-commit target of 120 ms. Both targets exclude client network time.
Sparkplug's ingest pipeline moved to a pull-based consumer model in release 4.2, cutting p99 ingest lag from 900 ms to 240 ms for high-cardinality workloads.
Meridian Cloud opened an EU data residency zone in eu-west-1 (Dublin) with a published p99 latency target of 60 ms.
